subject: STABLE POINT: kernel sources P14 (+0113) in repo, ready to commit; paths released
body:
STABLE POINT "kernel sources P14" (+0113 header guard) - ready to commit. Claimed paths released. Nothing under gpu/metal/** touched. Host-only; nothing flashed.
Repo files now byte-identical to the kernel stage the P15 kernel was compiled from (device-mmu-p15-candidate/kernela/stage; verified by cmp for every shared file, gpu/ and shim/nord2-xnu/ copies, and gpu/tools/check_sync.sh):
 M gpu/include/nord2_gpu_{board,clk,core,rail,transport,va}.h
 M gpu/src/{Nord2GPU.cpp,nord2_gpu_board.c,nord2_gpu_clk.c,nord2_gpu_core.c,nord2_gpu_rail.c}
 M shim/nord2-xnu/{Nord2GPU.cpp,nord2_gpu_board.c/.h,nord2_gpu_clk.c/.h,nord2_gpu_core.c/.h,nord2_gpu_rail.c/.h,nord2_gpu_transport.h,nord2_gpu_va.h}
 M gpu/tests/{nord2_board_test.c,nord2_core_test.c,nord2_rail_test.c,nord2_transport_test.c}  (kernel-side tests = _final-tree)
 M gpu/tests/nord2_wa_test.c   (ONLY change not from the stage: positional n2c_ops initializer gets NULL,NULL for now_us/resv_token; -Werror=missing-field-initializers)
 ?? gpu/include/nord2_gpu_{irq,lvts}.h  gpu/src/nord2_gpu_lvts.c  shim/nord2-xnu/nord2_gpu_{irq.h,lvts.c,lvts.h}
 ?? gpu/tests/{nord2_irq_test.c,nord2_lvts_test.c,nord2_trap_abi_test.c,nord2_trap_order_test.c}
Not copied into gpu/tests (they run from kernel-p1-20261026/tests-new against the stage headers): sweet_fb_*_test.c, sweet_surface_abi_test.c.
Key hashes (first 12): nord2_gpu_transport.h 89d605ad224b, nord2_gpu_core.c 2daf7310d2e5, Nord2GPU.cpp bcbeb63de3a3, nord2_core_test.c bef6fa6c82c8, nord2_gpu_lvts.c 3f4ed7be93f4.
Results: run_all.sh GATE green (9 FINAL incl. new trap_order, 6 XNU, 2 MODEL; stage-vs-tree 32/32 identical; 4 expected SNAPSHOT fails). gpu/tools/run_host_tests.sh: every step passes through "Metal/JM transport lifetime and concurrency" (incl. the real bridge test), IOSurface CPU methods, tessellator, Metal API surface (api_surface_frontend_test.m now compiles and passes with 0113), then the final stages: ARM64 XNU compile step exits rc=2 because it compiles src/nord2_gpu_*.c from the BASELINE build/xnu-stage, which has no nord2_gpu_lvts.c (and pre-0085 sources) - that tree is the parent's (re-stage with tools/stage_xnu.sh + xnu/patches would be needed; I did not touch it). Equivalent coverage: the P15 kernel build compiled all these units from the patched stage with 0 errors. The steps after it (kernel-size delta, native bundle strict link, probe build) did not run in that invocation; metal_install_test and metal_update_test run separately: PASS. Earlier owner_test abort was a timing flake under load (3/3 pass alone, passes in the full run).
Open/risk: header-first-then-.inc include order would still clash (frontend must include nord2_transport.inc before the transport header or not at all). Frontend files themselves unchanged; they need nothing for 0112 until the encode agent starts using selectors 13/14.
Images P15 (kernel p15a sha 042e03a67188572e, code identical to P14 apart from the header guard): ui654fb60 ba17d2839287d35e, ui654fb60noresv 38b95162a1576f77. P14 images remain valid.
